title: cross_review envelope plan_text + convergence_id missing for some cycle types

evidence.contrast_with_v3_v4: diagnostic v3 (cyc-20260520T065441Z) + v4 (cyc-20260520T084112Z) showed suggested_prompt body of 15668 chars with proper <untrusted_*> tags. v5 cycle (which planned a change to .claude/agents/aria-cross-reviewer.md itself) showed empty body.

hypotheses_to_investigate: convergence_drainer.py:454 issue_cross_review_envelope call may pass empty/None primary_plan_text or challenger_plan_text for cycles where plan_started's plan_content cannot serialize cleanly (e.g., when cycle plans modify the agent prompt file itself, creating a self-referential dirty-tree state)
cycle_runner's plan_seed handling for git-diff-source cycles may yield empty plan_content {} that serializes to empty JSON
convergence_id=None at agent receipt suggests the kernel's request envelope had convergence_id field missing or null at create_agent_invocation_request — needs trace via grep
v10_5_scope: investigate + Tier-1 fix at envelope construction site so primary_plan_text + challenger_plan_text + convergence_id are NEVER empty when issue_cross_review_envelope is called — fail-fast with explicit GovernanceError at the bridge boundary
v10_4_workaround: ACCEPTED — endurance proceeds with this bug present. Cycles affected by F-017 will refuse at cross_review stage; remaining cycles converge or block per pre-V10.4 pattern. Operator gains 15-20 hours of real-Claude observation budget by NOT chasing F-017 in V10.4 sprint.

expected_endurance_behavior.interpretation: 1-6 cycles out of 20 will converge depending on which pressure-source-type triggers the F-017 codepath. Pattern analysis post-endurance teaches V10.5 the exact cycle-type discriminator.
